title: Retry a Command with Backoff
description: Wraps any command in a retry loop with fixed or exponential backoff and a max-attempts cap -- the standard workaround for flaky network mounts, a service that isn't up yet, or a transient scheduler/API call.

variables.name: COMMAND_DESCRIPTION
variables.prompt: One-line description of the command being retried (for log messages)

variables.name: COMMAND_TO_RUN
variables.prompt: The exact command to run (quote it exactly as you would type it yourself)

variables.name: INITIAL_DELAY_SECONDS
variables.prompt: Delay before the first retry, in seconds
